note: Geometry for the Zepbound Shorts (long-form 02). Source is OUR OWN clean cut - one locked kitchen-doorway camera, no burned graphics anywhere - so every shot is a full-bleed 9:16 talk crop. All numbers measured off full-resolution frames with Apple Vision.

talk.note: MEASURED on this roll with Apple Vision over all 49 beats: Dan's head top sits at SOURCE ROW 0 on every beat (the camera framed him to the top edge), so unlike the supplements set there is no dead ceiling to remove and cropTop MUST be 0 - any crop off the top cuts his hair. Full-height 738x1080 -> 1080x1580 is a 1.46x upscale. The picture is dropped to y=340 (not 310) so the two-line headline's ink (ends ~y300) keeps >=40px of black between it and his hair, which now starts exactly at the picture's top edge.
talk.tightNote: PUNCH-IN. Alternates with the wide crop at every join to hide it. 678x992 from the TOP (tightTop 0 - his head is at row 0, so the punch crops the bottom, never the top), same delivered aspect, 1.59x upscale; his head lands at the same delivered y so only the framing moves.

card.note: Unused in this batch - the clean master carries no graphics to preserve.

audio.note: ⚠ UNLIKE THE AB-WHEEL BATCH, THIS SOURCE HAS NO MUSIC BED - the 8/27 rebuild added inserts, not a bed, and the style gate's bed check reads 0.8-1.1x on videos that carry none. So there is no bar to drop into and no bed to stop dead, and the fades are short: just enough to keep a splice from ticking. Durations are preserved exactly (no acrossfade), so picture and sound stay frame-locked.

dropNote: STANDING RULE (Dan, 2026-08-28): the title never sits on his face or abs - the picture is DROPPED below the title band and the J2 field carries the title. On THIS roll his head is at source row 0, so headY == dropTop exactly; the clearance that matters is title-ink-bottom to dropTop, held at >=40px (qc.js measures it off the rendered title PNGs). dropTop 340: picture 1080x1580, window 738x1080.
titleScrimNote: The scrim ends exactly where the dropped picture starts, so it can never reach the picture. It still earns its place on CARD shots, whose stage top is y170 - there the title crosses the top of the card, which is sky.
titleNote: STANDING RULE (Dan, 2026-08-28): the title holds for the WHOLE short, on the black field only, never over the picture. The picture is dropped to y=310 to make room. Supersedes the V4-era 'title must not stay up the whole video' rule, which was written when the title sat on his face.
